description: Candidate changes for the next verification rules version. Nothing here changes a rule: each entry is a fixture pinned at the CURRENT behaviour by packages/verify-core/test/rules-next-backlog.test.ts. An entry moves into a release only through the normal process: rule change, version bump, rules-changelog.json entry with a held-out before / after, and the pin updated to the new behaviour.

entries.priority: low: no benchmark verdict changes; verify-parity clips the phrase on its side
entries.found_by: rules 2.1.0 release: verify-parity's eCFR fixtures (a list item and the sentence after it, re-punctuated ". A" → "; a")
entries.summary: The 2.1.0 trailing-exception phrase reads up to 60 characters past its trigger and can cross a full stop when the text holds several sentences ("… are not eligible to participate in the Program. Dormitories are covered sepa"). Verify's own claim checks read a clause context, so a verdict changes only if a limiting next sentence is attached to it; 0 of 2,040 benchmark predictions are affected.

fixture.text: Residents of a commercial boarding house are not eligible to participate in the Program. Dormitories are covered separately.

condition_texts: Residents of a commercial boarding house are not eligible to participate in the Program. Dormitories are covered sepa

entries.candidate: End the phrase at the sentence end (a full stop followed by a space and a capital), as verify-parity now does. Direction: shorter phrases can only remove a dropped-condition row, so it can release more: a major version under the changelog policy, with a dev check and a held-out run.
entries.impact_today: Condition text shown in evidence can include the start of the next sentence.

entries.found_by: verify-parity deploy smoke (PR #9): support-bot example, kb/plans.md edited "Eastern Time" → "Eastern time"
entries.summary: A source edit that changes only the capitalisation of a proper noun (a time zone) drops a verbatim claim from supported to not adjudicated in code-only mode.

fixture.answer: Phone support is available only on the Business plan, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time.

sources.text: Phone support is available only on the Business plan, Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern time.

control.note: the same answer against the source as first written ("Eastern Time")

entries.candidate: Let the verbatim tier match through a case-only difference in a token outside numbers and identifiers ("Eastern Time" / "Eastern time"), keeping case-sensitive comparison for codes and identifiers. Direction: releases more (unverifiable → supported), so a major version under the changelog policy; needs a held-out run.
entries.impact_today: None on release: unverifiable is held, never released. In Verify Gate's document change mode, verify-parity reads the edit as cosmetic and the linked test passes with that reason.
